rationale: The original momentum-continuation thesis has stalled: price slipped below the 5m 9-EMA ($27.49) and the last candle probed the $27.42 invalidation level before a weak bounce, with no extension above $27.68 despite 9.2x relative volume. With unrealized P&L slightly negative and the setup failing, the edge has decayed; closing locks in capital and avoids the near stop, while the bearish case is not strong enough (price still above VWAP, 88.8% of range) to justify a flip short.
